FFmpeg is a separate executable, copyright the FFmpeg developers and
its listed contributors. The bundled unmodified binary is
ffmpeg-win-x86_64-v7.1.exe from the imageio-ffmpeg 0.6.0 Windows wheel,
identified as 7.1-essentials_build-www.gyan.dev. It is GPL version 3 or later.
The BSD license of the imageio Python wrapper is separate from FFmpeg's license.
See COPYING.GPLv3 and BUILD-CONFIGURATION.txt, including its SHA256.

FFmpeg 7.1 source release: https://ffmpeg.org/releases/ffmpeg-7.1.tar.xz
FFmpeg source tag: https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg/tree/n7.1
Upstream binary provider and release/source links:
https://www.gyan.dev/ffmpeg/builds/
https://github.com/GyanD/codexffmpeg/releases/tag/7.1
Imageio wheel packaging sources:
https://github.com/imageio/imageio-ffmpeg/tree/v0.6.0
External libraries and their sources/licenses are identified by the upstream
build provider and FFmpeg build configuration. NeuroBridge invokes FFmpeg as
an independent process to decode audio and does not link FFmpeg into Python.
